context: A dad and son play catch
purpose: Teach: 合図/当てる/早くから/年配/誉め/会わ/刺し/掛ける

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 翔、合図したらキャッチね。
lines.en: Sho, when I give you the signal, catch it.
lines.style: Light, playful instruction. Unhurried. Dad-voice — the kind that assumes cooperation without demanding it. A slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!ボールを真ん中に当てるよ!
lines.style: Eager and clear, with the unselfconscious confidence of a six-year-old. Sharp attack on the first syllable. Quick pace, building slightly at the end like he's already imagining the catch.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 朝早くから来てよかったな。
lines.en: It was good we came early.
lines.style: Contented, matter-of-fact. Quiet observation — not seeking agreement, just thinking out loud. Warm undertone. Pace: slow and present, like he's taking in the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 隣の年配のおじいちゃんも、見てたね。
lines.en: That older grandpa next door was watching us.
lines.style: Slight wonder in the delivery. Gently observant — the way he notices things adults miss. Not excited, just matter-of-fact. Small pause before 'was watching' like he's remembering the detail.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 頑張りを、誉めてくれた。
lines.style: Warm and affirming. Proud without overselling it — just relaying what happened. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'you' — making sure Sho knows the praise was for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、まだ会わずに、お弁当作ってる?
lines.en: Is Mom still at home making lunch?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not demanding. Soft questioning lilt at the end. The kind of question a six-year-old asks when he's starting to wonder about the other things happening around him. Unrushed.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お弁当の梅干し、種を刺して串、刺さってる。
lines.en: The bento has umeboshi on a skewer — pit and all.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate dad-humor. Light, knowing tone like he's sharing an inside joke about mom's practical style. Slight amusement underneath. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 帰りに、近所に声を掛けるようにして、皆呼ぼう!
lines.en: On the way back, let's invite the neighbors over!
lines.style: Sudden shift to bright energy. Quick pace, building momentum toward the end. Open, generous tone — the impulse to include people he likes. Ends on an upswing, inviting rather than commanding.
